appDescription.message: Export your WhatsApp Web contacts to Google Contacts or your phone. Your contacts, no longer stuck in WhatsApp.

popupWhy.message: If WhatsApp bans you, your contacts can still live somewhere else.

popupGoogleDesc.message: The exact columns Google Contacts needs to import.

popupPhoneDesc.message: A file for your phone's contacts. You can sync it with Telegram later.

popupExcelDesc.message: To review or edit. It doesn't add them to your contacts.

popupJsonDesc.message: A technical backup, or for another tool.
